method: Entire Chinese source read, independently translated as prose, then reread during drafting and source-block alignment checked. Old condensed English not used as translation base. No claim of independent native-speaker review.
corrections_and_limits: Ep01: Europe/Asia/Africa explicitly nicknames for wheat/maize/sorghum steamed breads, never a continental map opening.

Ep02: years of hard work retained; unverified decade-plus brick-kiln chronology narrowed to years. Labour and cancer juxtaposed as literary reading, not proven medical causation. Voluntary versus constrained options retained without categorically excluding exploitation.
Ep03: pressure attributed to aunt and Xu Guoqiang invoking Tian Fujun, not informed political coercion by Tian Fujun. Divorce described as severe social cost, not a legal impossibility.

Ep03: accident and relational change treated as interpretation; amputation does not make someone unable to give, ask or love. Alcohol-related accident not declared categorically nonaccidental or solely caused by unreturned affection.

Ep04: no assertion that an official daughter can secure any job in one sentence. Death read structurally without proving authorial necessity or impossibility for all such couples. Rescue is her own choice to save a child, not a claim it was for nobody.
Ep04/05: Jin Xiu proposes working in the mine hospital; provincial-capital transfer proposal comes from Lanxiang and Wu Zhongping. Separate romantic refusal from refusal of transfer.
Ep05: Wang Shicai rescues An Suozi while Shaoping witnesses; he does not die pushing Shaoping to safety. All later references changed consistently.
Ep05: final scene contains Huiying, Mingming and dog approaching; no invented shouted dialogue or established remarriage.
Ep05: 1988 completion to 1992 death is four years; intense writing not certified as medical cause of death. Writing has readers and effects, not literally no usefulness.

Ep04 blocks 29–44: original second-volume chapter 53 confirms Xiaoxia facilitated recruitment and proposed a later transfer, using her fathers name without his direct arrangement. Categorical never-arranged/never-proposed claims replaced by the tension between real help and recognition of Shaopings own judgment. Ep05 already avoids claiming she never helped.
verification_reports_received_from: Sibling moon agent reported checking original novel chapters and Peoples Daily biography; this translator used those specific reports, not a separate original-novel verification.

subsequent_independent_review.note: The preceding self-review records the authoring stage. Independent full review has since completed; current final body counts and hash below supersede earlier drafting counts.
